keyword: how many golfers have won the masters back to back
claims: As of April 13, 2026, four golfers have won the Masters Tournament in back-to-back years.
Rory McIlroy won the Masters Tournament in 2025 and 2026.
Jack Nicklaus won the Masters Tournament in 1965 and 1966.
Nick Faldo won the Masters Tournament in 1989 and 1990.
Tiger Woods won the Masters Tournament in 2001 and 2002.
Rory McIlroy is only the fourth player to defend their title at Augusta National.
